verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail is a SaaS with a developer API, so agent-oriented docs are a fair question to ask of it. Direct probes found no llms.txt, no markdown version of the developer docs, and no OpenAPI spec (all HTTP 404). The only related evidence is a generic mention of an API and Zapier, which is not agent-oriented documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
